summary: B8: the expedition bridge gains save_json/load_json over ExpeditionState's existing canonical JSON, and CampaignSession gains new_game, save_to_slot, continue_newest and list_slots over user://saves/<slot>.json, with newest decided by the save's own campaign day and strategic hour rather than by file time.

coordination.notes: B16 is changing configure and resolve_midnight in godot_bridge.rs and B17 begin_pending_battle/create_debug_battle; this lane appends two #[func]s at the end of the Project42ExpeditionBridge impl block and touches no existing function there, so all three merge as keep-both tails.
